verdict.rationale: The axis applies to an AI app builder, but no evidence item documents an interactive live preview of the app during building and before publishing. The closest item, "AI shows previews before it touches anything", describes previewing AI design options before they are applied, which is an adjacent feature. References to the app editor and the browser-based testing agent also do not show a founder interacting with a pre-publish preview.

support.subject: As a founder, I can interact with a live preview of my app while building, before publishing
